rules.title: Rules & Criteria
rules.description: Configure hard constraints, soft optimization weights, and locks.
rules.resetConfirm: Reset all rules to default settings?
rules.unsavedWarning: You have unsaved rule changes. Are you sure you want to leave?
rules.h1Desc: Each panel has exactly 3 positions: 2 setters and 1 reviewer, all distinct teachers.
rules.h2Desc: Teachers can only be assigned to panels for grades they actively teach.
rules.h3Desc: Each panel must include teachers from at least 2 distinct campuses.
rules.h4Desc: Each teacher participates in at most 1 panel per exam.
rules.h4Warning: When H4 is disabled, teachers can be assigned to multiple panels in the same exam, concentrating workload.
rules.h5Desc: Never assign teachers to exams where they have registered unavailability.
rules.h6Desc: Enforce pinned assignments and strictly prohibit forbidden teacher-panel pairs.
rules.h7Desc: Annual assignments per teacher must lie within tolerance [lo, hi] around calculated quota q.
rules.s1Desc: Each teacher should review 1 to 2 times annually to build evaluation experience.
rules.s1Example: Example: Teachers with 0 or >2 review roles incur penalty points.
rules.s2Desc: Keep reviewer ratio close to 1/3 of total assignments.
rules.s2Example: Example: A teacher with 3 assignments ideally has 2 setter and 1 reviewer role.
rules.s3Desc: Encourage reviewers from a different campus than both setters.
rules.s3Example: Example: Setters from Campus 1 and 2, reviewer from Campus 3 is ideal.
rules.s4Desc: Avoid having the same two teachers partner as setters repeatedly.
rules.s4Example: Example: If Teacher A and B partnered in MT1, avoid pairing them in FE2.
rules.s5Example: Example: If Teacher A reviewed Teacher B, rotate reviewers next exam.
rules.s6Desc: Avoid assigning a teacher as setter in consecutive exams.
rules.s6Example: Example: A setter in MT1 should ideally rest in FE1 before setting in MT2.
rules.s7Desc: Rotate multi-grade teachers across different grades.
rules.s7Example: Example: Teachers qualified for Grades 10 & 11 should set for both.
rules.s8Desc: Keep actual assignments close to theoretical quota q based on load weight.
rules.s8Example: Example: Teacher with weight 1.0 and q=3.2 receives 3 or 4 assignments.
